svg.aria-label: A radiology report shown as observations pointing into vocabulary definitions
svg.text: Left kidney demonstrated striated nephrogram, mild hydronephrosis, and perinephric stranding, consistent
with pyelonephritis. No associated abscess. Right kidney is unremarkable.
Solid pointers: report observations → definitions. Dashed guides: vocabulary scope and element bindings.
The sided location satisfies the unsided scope by SUBTYPE_OF; observation relationships do not point to definition relationships.
